name: uberdev
description: GitHub workflow commands: /solve spawns autonomous agents in cmux/Ghostty/iTerm to solve issues with tier-aware triage; /issue creates well-investigated, deduped, label-validated issues. Full Superpowers skill suite ported and rebranded for UberDev: brainstorm (with browser-based visual companion), write-plan, execute-plan, subagent-driven-dev (wave-based parallel execution), finish-branch, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, using-git-worktrees, dispatching-parallel-agents, verification-before-completion, requesting/receiving-code-review, writing-skills, using-uberdev. Bundles PR review agents (code-reviewer, code-simplifier, comment-analyzer, plan-reviewer, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, type-design-analyzer) and a SessionStart hook that injects the using-uberdev primer. v0.3.0 ports the remaining Superpowers skills, adds the brainstorm visual companion (local server + frame-template.html, persisting sessions to .uberdev/brainstorm/), and brings hooks + plugin docs over.
